digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions / CI/CD dispatch and runner scheduling
propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow_dispatch on main (609 runs through 2026-08-13) dominated the period, not tickets-branch pushes (zero runs); tickets branch is orphan with no .github/ directory and cannot trigger workflows

Peak incident-period burst 2026-08-13 20:30 UTC reached 22 waiting runner jobs and 873s max wait; current-shape burst 2026-08-15 17:30 UTC reached 22 waiting jobs with 197s max wait, indicating shared-org contention beyond repository-local queue

Current full-route Verified workflow has per-run slot cost of 17 (no mutation) to 24 (seven mutation shards) runner jobs; immediate fan-out after classify is 13 jobs with peak theoretical runnable demand of 19

Organization navapbc is on GitHub Free plan (20 total / 5 macOS concurrent limit per public documentation); Actions API provides no historical org-wide timeline so measured queue depth is repository-local lower bound
